name: power-platform-harness
description: Installs a Power Platform / Dynamics 365 CE development harness with skills written in natural language: prepares the machine and proposes installs and updates, writes agent instructions, per-technology development standards and the per-branch feature solution workflow into the repository, and checks the connections to DEV. Scaffolds a new repository, or adopts an existing one by reading its publisher, prefix, core solution and stack, and adapting the standards to the versions it already uses.
